Mod.title: Girls' Frontline 2: Door Kickers
Mod.author: beanpuppy
Mod.description:
[h2]Girls' Frontline 2: Door Kickers[/h2] [code]Commander, you're here. Good.
We've been assigned operations in the contaminated zones. The areas are still unstable; Hostile forces have moved in, taken hostages, fortified positions. Someone needs to clear them out.
I know it's dangerous work, but... we'll be careful. Just give us the orders and we'll see it through.
What do you say, Commander?[/code]
[h3]Overview[/h3] This mod imports tactical dolls from Girls' Frontline 2: Exilium as playable units in Door Kickers. Each doll comes equipped with their signature weapon and is grouped by their faction affiliations for tactical operations.
[h3]Units[/h3] [b]Task Force DEFY:[/b] Alva, Voymastina [b]H.I.D.E 404:[/b] Klukai, Mechty, Andoris, Belka, Leva, Lenna, Vector [b]Zucchero Café:[/b] Springfield, Makiatto, Centaureissi, Sharkry [b]Groza Squad:[/b] Groza, Nemesis, Krolik, Colphne, Vepley [b]Elmo Combined Echelon:[/b] Peritya, Sabrina, Qiuhua, Peri, Florence, Nikketa, Helen, Lewis [b]Frostfall Squad:[/b] Qiongju, Cheeta, Tololo, Lind [b]Monsoon Squad:[/b] Daiyan, Jiangyu, Zhaohui, Faye
[i]Note: Only dolls currently available in GFL2 are/will be included.[/i]
[h3]To-do[/h3] To see our roadmap and what we're currently working on, visit the [url=https://trello.com/b/y77gdE1R/girl-kickers]Trello board.[/url]
Want to help or contribute? Visit the [url=https://github.com/beanpuppy/girl-kickers]GitHub repository.[/url]
[h3]Known Limitations[/h3] Door Kickers 2 expects uniform model sizes, causing visual issues when importing GFL2 dolls with varying heights and builds. Tall, skinny dolls like Nemesis and short dolls like Colphne are particularly affected by these scaling requirements. We are working to minimise these issues while keeping dolls in their correct outfits.
Due to these limitations, models are optimised for the default top-down view rather than freelook mode. Any visual issues only visible in freelook will not be considered bugs.
[h3]Credits[/h3] Contributors: [list] [*] beanpuppy [*] Setlys [*] Housenflou [*] MistressAshai [*] Charlie Sparky [/list] Special thanks to: [list] [*] MICA Team - Girls' Frontline 2: Exilium [*] kenji1997 - AssetStudio fork for model extraction [*] [url=https://www.instagram.com/luwiss96/]Luwis96[/url] - Commissioned weapon UI images [*] Everyone giving suggestions and reporting bugs [/list]
[h3]Community Patches:[/h3] [list] [*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3586738239]Chinese localisation[/url] [*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3595646925]Korean localisation[/url] [*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3605426442]Japanese localisation[/url] [/list]

New Content - Added Monsoon squad: Daiyan (QBZ-95), Jiangyu (QBZ-97), Zhaohui (CS/LS06), Faye (CZ 75) - Added suppressed weapon variants some weapons - Added 14 custom scopes from iron sights to 25x magnification - Reworked armour into 6 new items: Recreation, Law Enforcement, B.R.I.E.F., Elite, Deichgraf, Nosorog - Added 5 neural cores (helmets): Basic, Vanguard, Sentinel, Bulwark, Support - Added lockpick as universal doll equipment
Weapon Rebalance - Complete overhaul of all weapon stats - damage, accuracy, reload times, and fire behaviour rebuilt from scratch for every weapon in the mod - New attack type system giving each weapon its own set of firing behaviours across standardised range bands, replacing the old shared attack types - New per-weapon ammo types with unique stats, plus alternate ammo options for most weapons including AP rounds, suppression rounds, and specialty ammo - DMRs, snipers, and LMGs now benefit from mounted positions with reduced aim time when in cover - Shotgun pump action reworked with cyclic reload - Accuracy, concealment, and suppression values rebalanced across all weapon classes to better reflect weapon type and role
Doll Rebalance - Health, FOV, movement speed, and suppression recovery flattened and standardised across all dolls, with a few exceptions for dolls that should stand out e.g. AK-15 - Default loadout standardised: iron sights, doorkick, lockpick, basic core, night vision, combat frame - Old equipment system replaced with new armour frame and neural core system
